verdicts.note: Taiwan 1906-1943 monthly death and birth series, cross-correlating pandemic excess deaths with the subsequent birth deficit. A second setting for the 1918 shock design.
Cameroon two-hospital case-control.
Mozambique stillbirth case-control.
Parental karyotype and subsequent live births in 3,235 recurrent-loss couples.
Loss history and early menopause.
US stillbirth rates 1980-2020 by race, with age-period-cohort decomposition.
High-income stillbirth variation; duplicate of the Lancet series item.
Depression history and later miscarriage/stillbirth; cross-file D.3.a.
North-east India teaching hospital IUFD prevalence; weak.
Old Order Amish parental relatedness and adverse reproductive outcomes. Third consanguinity design after Ober and the Palestinian study, and a natural-fertility population.
Bamenda regional hospital case-control.

Prospective five-year Hutterite study reporting fecundability AND fetal loss rates separately under HLA sharing. Companion to the Ober anchor and a rare natural-fertility decomposition of the two margins.
Subclinical hypothyroidism and thyroid autoimmunity against time-to-pregnancy, loss and live birth; null, and it separates the margins.

Population Studies 1963. Decomposes the birth interval into gestation, post-partum amenorrhoea, anovulation, conception wait, and TIME ADDED BY PREGNANCY WASTAGE. This is the formal statement of the chapter's accounting argument -- a loss costs an interval, not a birth -- and it predates Bongaarts.
Spatial and Bayesian-network analysis of stillbirth rates across 194 countries.
Demography 1971 Monte Carlo fertility microsimulation used to quantify bias in estimated sterility, foetal death and stillbirth ratios. Both an accounting model and a measurement argument.
Previous loss as a risk factor in the next pregnancy, 72 South American hospitals.
Registry-based maternal risk factors for stillbirth.
Travel time to facility and stillbirth, Gombe; geospatial case-control.
ICD-PM versus CODAC classification of stillbirths.
ICD-PM applied in north-east Nigeria.
Community-based mother-infant cohorts in Madagascar, Cambodia and Senegal.
Paternal-cell immunisation trial in recurrent abortion. The outcome is post-loss conception, but the variation is a clinical treatment.
Seven decades of Hong Kong stillbirth and neonatal death since 1946. Long-run series spanning the late FDT in a high-income Asian setting.
Pemba Island prospective stillbirth cohort.
Fetal death case-control, Cuiaba, Brazil.
Air pollution and stillbirth, Sydney.
Obstetric and medical risk factors, Kenya case-control.
Secondary analysis of the WOMAN tranexamic-acid trial.
Machine-learning stillbirth prediction.
Placental syncytiotrophoblast markers.
Gestational-age-specific stillbirth rates and the choice of denominator; three competing methodologies compared.
Fetuses-at-risk versus birth-based denominators across 126.5 million births. The denominator problem at scale, which governs whether a loss rate is comparable across populations.
Stillbirth risk during the 1918 pandemic, 21,334 Maricopa County birth records. Individual-level records for the shock the aggregate series only infers.
Obstetric-care accessibility and stillbirth, The Gambia.

Morocco: constructs an intrauterine-mortality life table with early and late fetal components AND estimates its effect on women's fertility. Exactly the chapter's primary estimand, in a mid-transition setting. Obscure venue; retrieval and quality check are priorities.
Colombian stillbirth before and during COVID.
GBD 2015 stillbirth and child mortality levels 1980-2015.
Population-based rates and causes across south Asia and sub-Saharan Africa.
Global Network population-based birth registry stillbirth trends.
Stillbirths before 28 weeks across 19 European countries -- the burden hidden by the 28-week reporting threshold.
Cause-of-death classification challenges in low-income settings.
Insulin resistance and recurrent early loss; cross-file B.4 metabolic.
Stillbirths attributable to PM2.5 in 137 countries; an attributable-burden calculation, so it is an accounting exercise on the determinant side.
Clinical review. No abstract.

Cytogenetics of spontaneous abortion: over half of early miscarriages carry chromosomal abnormalities. The direct evidence for the SELECTION_VIABILITY caution -- averted loss does not convert one-for-one into a surviving birth.
2022 birth declines in Germany and Sweden; a fertility-decline study with no loss channel.
Counting stillbirths; Lancet comment.
Zimbabwe: stillbirths and early neonatal deaths reported as one perinatal category.
